items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Fetches the reinforcement layouts recorded for a component as bars: one polyline per bar, one tree branch per layout record, the newest record first, with the diameter (mm), steel grade and cover of every bar, and the id, basis, snapshot and status of every record. Optionally the bars are made solid (Pipes). Input can be: - Geometry carrying the 'csc_component' user text - A component passport JSON string ({identity, snapshots[]}) - A raw identity_id or snapshot_id
The points of a layout are stored coordinates of the snapshot it belongs to. A passport with a placement (ApplyFrame, TransformComponent) moves the layouts of its own snapshot to where the element is placed, like the Fetch geometry components do for the mesh; layouts of another version stay in their stored coordinates and are named in a warning. Document units are taken as millimetres (1:1); a document in another unit gets a warning. Status: published (default), draft, pending, rejected, withdrawn or all (adds your own unpublished records).
